title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 host name verification was missing for server TLS certificates…
description: JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 lack host name verification for server TLS certificates. This means the software does not properly verify that the server's TLS certificate matches the expected host name, potentially allowing man-in-the-middle attacks. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.4 (CVSS 3.1).
